events.name: Kara Frazier, Emily Lehr & the Foxglove Fellows, and Van Gilder
events.info: Doors 6PM | Show 7PM$10 ADV | $15 DOS21+ Kara Frazier: Nashville-based singer-songwriter Kara Frazier is a rare artist who inhabits the space between eras. Originally from Jacksonville, FL, she has spent over a decade honing a sound that blends bluesy vocals with southern roots and a pop-soul feel. Emily Lehr & the Foxglove Fellows: A native West Virginian, Emily Lehr finds inspiration in the Appalachian traditions of communal music-making and raw lyricism. From cozy solo performances in the living room to lively shows with her band, the Foxglove Fellows, Emily connects with live audiences to bring her stories to life with friends old and new. Van Gilder: Van Gilder is a should and r&b inspired rock band based in Pittsburgh, PA. Founded in 2016 by longtime friends and collaborators Adelaide Estep and Connor Bragg, the band quickly found their sound by blending different influences to cultivate something unique.

Children under the age of 2 do not require a ticket to attend a Pittsburgh Penguins home game provided they sit on the lap of an adult throughout the game. Any child who has celebrated their 2nd birthday will need a ticket to enter the building.
